deviations: shots().gatherMs is an absolute x (startMs + afterMs + gather atMs), not an offset.

The e2e compares targets to the fit now (directedCamera().fit), not the fit recorded at entry: the board drifts a little (e.g. x 0 to 29 world units at 0.056 scale) as the day's state changes, so a fixed entry fit would fail. The seek still lands on the fit of that moment.
Quasar e2e uses STAR_CHART_PARADIGM 'solar' (as montage-names); Pulsar uses ''.
recap pull-back also checks framing on and no unsuspended follow (packet said 'conditions in 1').
limitations: In the Pulsar climax the cast (11 pieces) spans the whole board, so the shot mostly pans (scale stays at the fit) rather than zooms; the human should judge the feel from the stills.
After a montage pull-back the camera does not re-fit if the board drifts later in the beat (a few px); the shot then reads as not holding.
solar-dense serial mode skips the rest of the file after a failure, so those cases were run with -g.
montage-names failed once in a parallel batch and passed alone (load flake).
